z-m-07-09.title: Gurasa mai jan wake nawa ya kamata gidan burodi ya gasa Litinin mai zuwa?
z-m-07-09.topic: Hasashen abin da zai faru daga bayanan sayarwa (yadda za a kula da ƙima ta musamman).
z-m-07-09.goal: Ka san cewa yayin hasashen abin da zai faru daga bayanai, yadda za a kula da ƙima ta musamman ya danganta da dalilinta; ka sake duba hasashenka da amincewarka idan sabon bayani ya zo, ka rubuta shi a cikin saƙo.
z-m-07-09.material: Gidan burodi na unguwa yana gasa gurasa mai jan wake kowace safiya don sayarwa a wannan rana. Idan ya yi yawa wasu kan rage, idan ya yi kaɗan kuma ba ya isa. Mai gidan yana son yanke adadin da zai gasa Litinin mai zuwa ta duba bayanan sayarwar makon da ya gabata. Makon jiya shagon yana buɗe kowace rana daga Litinin zuwa Juma'a.
z-m-07-09.thinking.0: Yi hasashen girman da ya saba daga bayanai.
z-m-07-09.thinking.1: Kula da ƙima ta musamman ta hanyar binciken dalilinta.
z-m-07-09.thinking.2: Riƙe ko sake duba hukuncinka idan sabon bayani ya zo.
z-m-07-09.thinking.3: Faɗi yanayin da hasashenka zai iya canzawa.
z-m-07-09.prereq.0: Karanta lambobi daga teburai ko bayanai, ka bambanta lambobin da ke kusa da juna da ƙima ta musamman (matakin aji na 3).
z-m-07-09.s.s1.prompt: Mu yi hasashen nawa za a gasa Litinin mai zuwa yayin da muke samun bayanan sayarwa a hankali. A kowane mataki ka zaɓi abin da ka ga ya fi dacewa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.0: Jera lambobin sayarwar ranakun da aka sani zuwa yanzu, ka yi alama ga waɗanda ke kusa da juna da waɗanda suka bambanta.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.hint.1: Idan akwai lamba da ta bambanta, ka yi tunanin hanyar bincika ko wani abu ya faru a wannan rana.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.info: An sayar da guda 12 Litinin, 14 Talata, 13 Laraba.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kusan gurasa mai jan wake nawa zai dace a gasa Litinin mai zuwa?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Ranakun ukun sun yi kama, 12 zuwa 14, saboda haka kusan 13, ko da ƙarin kariya kusan 14, ya dace. Tunda kwanaki 3 kawai muka gani, 'ina so in ƙara lura kaɗan' ma ya dace, amma bayanan yanzu ma suna ba mu damar faɗin ƙima ta kusanci.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan ya fi yawan ranar da aka fi sayarwa a cikin kwanakin ukun. Duba ko bayanan sun ba da dalilin ƙara adadin haka.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya zaɓi matsakaici domin sayarwar kwanaki ukun tana kusa, 12 zuwa 14.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya ƙara kaɗan domin ƙarancin kaya ya fi damuwa da ragowa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kwanaki 3 kawai muka gani, ba za mu iya yanke shawara ba.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hali ne mai taka-tsantsan. Duk da haka kusancin lambobin kwanakin ukun na iya ba da alama.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Alhamis an sayar da 31. Mai gidan bai san dalilin da ya sa aka sayar da yawa a Alhamis ba tukuna.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ta yaya tunaninka game da adadin da za a gasa Litinin mai zuwa ya canza?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Ba tare da sanin dalilin da ya sa 31 ya fito ba, duka 'a tsaya kusan 13 a gano dalili' da 'a tanadi ƙari, kusan 17 zuwa 18' sun dace. Abin da ya haɗa su shi ne bai kamata a amince da 31 kai tsaye ko a goge shi ba tare da dalili ba.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: A ƙara kusantar 31. Wannan shi ne bayanin baya-bayan nan.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin ko kasancewar bayanin baya-bayan nan dalili ne na amincewa da 31. Yaya ya bambanta da lambobin sauran kwanaki ukun?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Bayanan Alhamis kuskure ne, a goge shi.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Babu shaida cewa bayanin kuskure ne. Ya fi kyau a bincika dalilin da ya sa ya yi yawa maimakon goge shi ba tare da shaida ba.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: A riƙe hasashen farko, amma a bincika dalilin da ya sa Alhamis ta yi yawa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da bai amince ko goge ƙimar da ta yi nisa nan take ba, sai dai ya nemi dalilinta.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: A tara kwanaki huɗun, a raba da 4, a gasa kusan 17 zuwa 18.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ƙima mai nisa ma bayanin gaskiya ne, saboda haka ana haɗa ta, amma tana ɗaga matsakaici. Har yanzu ba mu san ko Litinin mai zuwa za ta zama kamar Alhamis ba.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Juma'a an sayar da 13. Mun kuma gano cewa a Alhamis an yi bikin kwana ɗaya a wurin shakatawa kusa. Babu biki kusa da wurin Litinin mai zuwa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu, gurasa nawa zai dace a gasa Litinin mai zuwa?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Alhamis rana ce da aka sayar da yawa saboda biki na musamman, babu kuma biki Litinin mai zuwa, saboda haka sauran ranaku huɗu (12, 14, 13, 13) su ne jagora mafi dacewa. Kusan 13, ko 15 tare da ɗan kari, ya dace. Bambancin shi ne ɗalibin da ya riƙe hasashen farko har ƙarshe ma ya ƙara amincewa bayan sanin dalili.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: An ce babu biki Litinin mai zuwa. Ka yi tunanin ko dalilin samun 31 zai sake faruwa.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ta yaya ka nuna a lissafinka cewa Alhamis ba rana ce ta yau da kullum ba, rana ce da biki ya faru?
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan aka cire Alhamis, ranar bikin, sauran ranaku sun yi kama, 12 zuwa 14. Wannan hukunci ne da ya zaɓi matsakaicinsu.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da ya ƙara ɗan kari bisa kusan 13.
z-m-07-09.s.s1.reflect: Shigar da 31 na Alhamis cikin lissafi ko cire shi yana canza hasashenka sosai. Faɗi dalilin da ya sa ka kula da lamba ɗaya dabam kafin da bayan sanin dalilinta. Ka kuma yi tunanin ko abin da ya faru sau ɗaya zai iya sake faruwa.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta saƙo ga mai gidan. Ka rubuta adadin da za a gasa Litinin mai zuwa, dalilin zaɓinsa, da yanayi guda da zai iya sa adadin ya canza.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sake karanta lambobin ranakun da ke kusa da Litinin, ka gano wacce rana ta fi kama.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin rana guda da adadin zai iya canzawa (biki, yanayi).
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka sake tabbatar cewa adadin da ka zaɓa yana kusa da lambobin bayanan?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta yadda ka kula da 31 na Alhamis (ka haɗa ko ka cire) da dalilinsa?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin 'yanayin da zai iya canza adadi' da ka rubuta da gaske zai iya canza adadin?
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.0: Ina so in gasa kusan 13. Litinin, Talata, Laraba, da Juma'a an sayar da 12 zuwa 14, 31 na Alhamis kuma ya faru ne saboda biki. Idan akwai biki kusa da shago Litinin ma, sai a gasa ƙari.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.model.1: Zan gasa kusan 15. Yawanci ana sayar da kusan 13, don haka na ƙara 2 don samun kari kaɗan, na cire 31 na Alhamis domin biki na musamman ne. Idan aka yi ruwan sama, ana iya sayar da kaɗan.
z-m-07-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wannan saƙo ne mai ɗan ƙarin kari.

z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a lamba ce mai lambobi biyu.
z-m-07-01.title: Shin samfurin lamba mai lambobi biyu da lamba mai lamba ɗaya koyaushe lamba ce mai lambobi uku?
z-m-07-01.topic: Yanke shawarar adadin lambobi a samfurin (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya).
z-m-07-01.goal: Ka san cewa ƴan misalan ninkawa da suka yi daidai ba sa tabbatar da 'koyaushe'; ƙirƙiri misalai naka inda samfurin lamba mai lambobi biyu da lamba mai lamba ɗaya yake da lambobi biyu, sannan ka faɗi lokacin da zai zama mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.material:
Doyun ya warware lissafin ninkawa, ya ce.
'37×4=148, 52×6=312, 78×9=702. Samfurin lamba mai lambobi biyu da lamba mai lamba ɗaya koyaushe lamba ce mai lambobi uku!'
(A nan lambar lambobi biyu tana tsakanin 10 zuwa 99, lamba mai lamba ɗaya kuma daga 2 zuwa 9. Ana karanta 37×4 da "talatin da bakwai sau huɗu".)
z-m-07-01.thinking.0: Bincika ko misalai da yawa daidai suna tabbatar da 'koyaushe'.
z-m-07-01.thinking.1: Ka ƙirƙiri da kanka misalan da za su karyata maganar.
z-m-07-01.thinking.2: Faɗi ma'aunin da ke raba lokacin da yake aiki da wanda ba ya aiki.
z-m-07-01.prereq.0: Karanta alamar ninkawar lamba mai lambobi biyu da mai lamba ɗaya, ka nemo ƙima (matakin aji na 3).
z-m-07-01.prereq.1: Ka san cewa 100 ita ce lamba ta farko mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da maganar Doyun? Yi hukunci cikin zangon da aka kayyade: lambobi biyu daga 10 zuwa 99 ne, lambobi ɗaya kuma daga 2 zuwa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta lambobin da Doyun ya gwada, 37, 52, da 78, da masu ninkawar da ya yi amfani da su, 4, 6, da 9, gefe da gefe; nemo yanayin da bai gwada ba.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ninka mafi ƙananan lambobi biyu da mafi girma biyu a zangon, ka ƙiyasta zangon da samfurin zai kasance.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.a: Ka ninka da lamba mai lamba ɗaya, saboda haka samfurin koyaushe yana da lambobi biyu.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.a: Kasancewar ɗaya daga cikin masu ninkawa yana da lamba ɗaya ba ya sa samfurin ya kasance mai lambobi biyu. Duba yawan lambobin samfurin 78×9 da Doyun ya bayar.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.b: Idan lambar mai lamba ɗaya 9 ce, samfurin koyaushe lamba ce mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.b: Ko da an ninka da 9, ana iya samun lamba mai lambobi biyu. Duba samfurin 10×9.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.c: Misalan ukun duk daidai ne, saboda haka Doyun ya yi gaskiya.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.c: Daidaitar misali guda ta bambanta da 'koyaushe' daidai. Kana buƙatar bincika ko akwai yanayin da ba a gwada ba tukuna.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.d: Wani lokaci lamba ce mai lambobi uku, wani lokaci kuma mai lambobi biyu.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ra'ayi ne cewa adadin lambobin samfurin na iya canzawa bisa girman lambobin da ake ninkawa. Yin misalai da gwadawa zai fayyace.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.explain: Mafi ƙaramin samfur a zangon shi ne 10×2=20, mafi girma kuma 99×9=891. Saboda haka samfurin na iya zama mai lambobi biyu ko uku, ba zai iya zama mai lambobi huɗu ba.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka yi misalai biyu da samfurori mabambanta da ke nuna maganar Doyun ba daidai ba ce. Zaɓi lamba mai lambobi biyu a (10 zuwa 99) da mai lamba ɗaya b (2 zuwa 9) ta yadda samfurin ba zai zama mai lambobi uku ba.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi ƙananan lambobi, ninka su, ka duba yawan lambobin samfurin.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi a guda, sannan ka canza b zuwa 2, 3, 4, ... ka nemo inda samfurin ya fara zama mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Sanya a cikakkiyar lamba daga 10 zuwa 99.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: b lamba ce mai lamba ɗaya (2 zuwa 9).
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Sanya b cikakkiyar lamba daga 2 zuwa 9.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Samfurin bai kai 100 ba, saboda haka ba lamba mai lambobi uku ba ce. Maganar Doyun ta karye.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Samfurin lamba ce mai lambobi uku ko fiye. Canza a ko b domin samfurin ya ragu.
z-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, 12×3=36, 20×4=80, da 45×2=90 duk lambobi ne masu lambobi biyu. 50×2=100 shi ne farkon lambobi masu lambobi uku, saboda haka ba misali ba ne. Misali guda kaɗai ya karya 'koyaushe'.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.prompt: Me kake son faɗa wa Doyun? Ta amfani da misalan da ka yi yanzu, ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa ya yi kuskure, sannan ka faɗi lokacin da samfurin zai zama mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.0: Za ka iya sake amfani da alamomin ninkawar misalan da ka fara yi yadda suke.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin lambar iyaka tsakanin lambobi masu lambobi biyu da masu uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A misalinka, ka sake lissafawa don tabbatar da cewa samfurin lambar lambobi biyu da mai lamba ɗaya da gaske yana da lambobi biyu?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta kana sane cewa misali ɗaya ya isa ya karya 'koyaushe'?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana lokacin da zai zama mai lambobi uku da lambobi (misali, 99×9) ko ma'auni (100 ko fiye)?
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.0: Abin da Doyun ya faɗa ba koyaushe ne daidai ba. Akwai yanayin da samfurin yake da lambobi biyu, kamar 12×3=36. Idan lambobin biyun manya ne kuma samfurin ya wuce 100, zai zama mai lambobi uku.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.1: A'a. 20×4=80 lamba ce mai lambobi biyu. Yayin da lambobin da ake ninkawa suka fi girma, samfurin ma yana ƙaruwa, saboda haka zai iya zama lamba mai lambobi uku kamar 99×9=891.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta ce 'lambobin sun fi girma' maimakon ma'aunin '100 ko fiye' ita ma ta dace.
z-m-07-01.s.s3.model.2: Lamba mai lambobi biyu na iya samuwa, kamar 12×3=36, don haka Doyun ya yi kuskure. Samfurin dole ya kai 100 ko fiye kafin ya zama mai lambobi uku.

z-m-07-03.title: Na raba lambar katin da 6, rabon ya zama 7. Menene lambar katin?
z-m-07-03.topic: Gano zangon mai rabawa daga rabon da ragowar rabon da yake da ragi
z-m-07-03.goal: Sanin rabon kawai ba ya ƙayyade mai rabawa zuwa lamba guda; nuna bayanin da ya ɓace (ragowar), sannan ka nemo lambobi da dama da suka cika sharadin da babbar lamba.
z-m-07-03.material: Soyul ta rufe katin lamba da hannunta ta ce, ‘Lambar da ke katin lamba ce ta halitta. Na raba ta da 6, rabon ya zama 7.’ Soyul ba ta faɗi ko akwai ragowar ba tukuna.
z-m-07-03.thinking.1: Samar da lambobi da dama da suka cika sharuddan
z-m-07-03.thinking.2: Bayyana zangon da ragowar za ta iya kasancewa
z-m-07-03.prereq.0: Sanin ma’anar rabo da ragowar rabon mai ragi (aji na 3)
z-m-07-03.s.s1.prompt: Za a iya tantance lambar katin daga maganar Soyul kaɗai zuwa lamba guda? Wane ƙarin bayani ake buƙata don ƙayyade ta?
z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta mafi ƙaramin lamba mai rabon 7. Ƙara 1, 2, 3, ... a jere ka duba ko rabon har yanzu 7 ne.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta duk lambobin da za su iya zama, sannan ka gano ƙarin bayani guda ɗaya da zai rage su zuwa lamba ɗaya.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.a: Ko da rabon iri ɗaya ne, idan ragowar ta bambanta, mai rabawar ma ya bambanta. Idan ka san ragowar, za ka iya tantance ɗaya daga cikin lambobin.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.o.b: Kana buƙatar sanin ko mara ko kuma ne
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.b: Sanin mara ko kuma yana rage zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ba ya ƙayyade guda ɗaya. Ƙirga adadin zaɓin lambobi marasa mara da masu mara da za ka iya samu.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana buƙatar sanin ko mai rabawa 6 daidai ne
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.c: Soyul ta riga ta faɗa cewa mai rabawa 6 ne. Wani ɓangare ne bai ƙayyade ba tukuna.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.r.d: 42 ɗaya ne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka, amma idan akwai ragowar ba 42 ba ce. Soyul ba ta ce rabon babu ragowa ba.
z-m-07-03.s.s1.explain: Idan rabon 7 ne, lambar katin ɗaya ce daga 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47 (ragowar daga 0 zuwa 5). Idan ka san ragowar, za ka iya tantance lamba ɗaya. Idan mara ko kuma kaɗai ka sani, zaɓi 3 ne za su rage a kowanne.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka ce lambar katin ba ta rabuwa da 6 babu ragowa. Rubuta lambobi uku daban-daban da za a iya sawa a katin, rabonsu 7 kuma suna da ragowa.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ko akwai ragowar bayan ka cire 6 daga lambar katin sau 7.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.1: Raba kowace lamba tsakanin 42 da 48 da 6 ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka duba ko rabon 7 ne ragowar kuma ba 0 ba.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambar da ke katin lamba ce ta halitta.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka sanya lambar katin ta zama lamba ta halitta da ta kai 1 ko fiye.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Rabon idan aka raba da 6 shi ne 7.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Rabon idan aka raba da 6 ba 7 ba ne. Ƙirga sau nawa za a iya cire 6.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c3: An raba ta da 6 babu ragowa (ragowar 0). Sauya ta zuwa lamba mai ragowa ba 0.
z-m-07-03.s.s2.explain: Lambobin da rabonsu 7 kuma suna da ragowa su ne 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, guda biyar. Su ne 42 da aka ƙara ragowar 1 zuwa 5.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.prompt: Menene mafi girman lambar da za a iya samu a katin? Bayyana dalilin da ya sa wannan ce mafi girma ta hanyar haɗa shi da ragowar.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ragowar da za ta iya fitowa ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga 0, sannan ka duba inda dole ka tsaya.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ta da mafi ƙaramin lamba mai rabon 8.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Mafi girman lamba ita ce ...
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka tabbatar cewa idan aka raba lambar da ka rubuta da 6, rabon 7 ne da gaske?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ragowar ba za ta kai 6 ko fiye ba?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka rubuta alaƙar cewa idan ragowar ta fi girma, mai rabawar ma ya fi girma?
z-m-07-03.s.s3.model.0: 47 ce. Ragowar dole ta yi ƙasa da mai rabawa 6, saboda haka mafi girman ragowar ita ce 5. 42 da aka ƙara 5 ya zama 47.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.model.1: 47 ce. Idan aka raba da 6, ragowar daga 0 zuwa 5 ce kaɗai za ta iya zama; idan 5 ce, 42+5=47 ita ce mafi girma.
z-m-07-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan bayani ya fara daga 6×7=42 sannan ya ƙara ragowar.

z-m-07-07.title: Yaushe ajin ninkaya na ‘minti 75’ a sanarwar zai ƙare?
z-m-07-07.topic: Lissafin lokacin rana da tsawon lokaci (mintuna) da karanta sanarwa
z-m-07-07.goal: Bincika ko bayanin lokaci a sanarwa ya kayyade lokacin ƙarewa guda ɗaya, nuna bayanin da ya ɓace (ko an haɗa hutun), sannan ka sake rubuta sanarwar domin iyaye kada su fahimce ta ba daidai ba.
z-m-07-07.material:
Sanarwar ajin ninkaya ta ce haka.
‘Ajin yana farawa da ƙarfe 3:40 na yamma. Ajin yana ɗaukar minti 75, kuma akwai hutun minti 10 a tsakiyar aji.’
Taron iyaye yana farawa da ƙarfe 5:00 na yamma. Dole ne ajin ya ƙare daidai ƙarfe 5:00 ko kafin nan domin iyaye su je taron. (Ana karanta 3:40 da ‘uku da minti arba’in.’)
z-m-07-07.thinking.1: Nemo lokuta da dama da suka dace da sharuddan
z-m-07-07.thinking.2: Sake rubuta jumla marar ma'ana ɗaya tilo kana la'akari da mai karatu
z-m-07-07.prereq.0: Karanta lokacin rana da tsawon lokaci (awa da mintuna), da cewa awa 1 mintuna 60 ce (matakin aji na 3)

z-m-07-08.title: Za mu iya sanin sakamakon haɗa ƙuri'un ba tare da sanin adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji ba?
z-m-07-08.topic: Karanta sakamakon ƙuri'u biyu a hade (bayani game da bambanci)
z-m-07-08.goal: Ka fahimci cewa bayanin da ake buƙata lokacin haɗa ƙuri'u ba ‘adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji’ ba ne, sai dai ‘nawa ne suka fi’, sannan ka tabbatar da bayyanawa ta ƙirƙirar misalai da dama masu adadin ƙuri'u daban-daban.
z-m-07-08.material:
Ajin 1 da Aji na 2 na aji na 3 sun zaɓi wurin yawon shakatawa ta hanyar ƙuri'a. Wuraren su ne gidan namun daji da gidan kayan tarihi, kuma kowane mutum ya jefa ƙuri'a guda ɗaya kawai.
Sakamakon Aji 1: gidan namun daji ya samu ƙuri'u 3 fiye da gidan kayan tarihi.
Sakamakon Aji 2: gidan kayan tarihi ya samu ƙuri'u 2 fiye da gidan namun daji.
Har yanzu ba mu san jimillar ƙuri'un kowane aji ko adadin ƙuri'un da kowanne wuri ya samu ba. Makaranta ta yanke shawarar haɗa ƙuri'un ajin biyun, a zaɓi wanda ya fi yawa.
z-m-07-08.thinking.1: Ka ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharuddan da kanka
z-m-07-08.thinking.2: Bayyana hukuncinka ta amfani da misalai

z-m-07-08.prereq.1: Kwarewar duba sakamakon ƙuri'a ta hanyar haɗa ajin biyu
z-m-07-08.s.s1.prompt: Idan muka haɗa ƙuri'un azuzuwan biyu, wane wuri ne ya samu ƙuri'u nawa fiye da ɗayan? Za mu iya sani?
z-m-07-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi saitin ƙuri'u guda ɗaya da ya dace da sakamakon Aji 1, da wani da ya dace da Aji 2, sannan ka haɗa ƙuri'un azuzuwan biyu.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sake zaɓar adadin ƙuri'u dabam, sannan ka kwatanta ko bambancin haɗaɗɗen sakamakon ya canza.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.o.a: Gidan namun daji yana da ƙuri'a 1 fiye
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya yi la'akari da abin da ke faruwa ga bambancin jimilla idan gidan namun daji ya yi gaba a aji ɗaya, gidan kayan tarihi kuma ya yi gaba a ɗayan. Zaɓi misali guda ka tabbatar.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Muna buƙatar sanin adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.b: Ko da ba ka san adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji ba, idan ka san ‘nawa ne suka fi’, za ka iya gano bambancin jimillar. Zaɓi adadin ƙuri'u na misali ka haɗa da kanka.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.o.c: Gidan namun daji yana da ƙuri'u 5 fiye
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin inda 3 da 5 suka fito. A Aji 2, gidan kayan tarihi ne ya fi. Ta yaya ya kamata a nuna wannan bambanci a sakamakon haɗin?
z-m-07-08.s.s1.o.d: An yi kunnen doki. Kowanne ya yi nasara sau ɗaya.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.r.d: Adadin ƙuri'un da aka haɗa ne ke yanke hukunci, ba sau nawa kowane aji ya yi nasara ba. Yin gaba da ƙuri'u 3 da yin gaba da ƙuri'u 2 girma dabam-dabam ne.
z-m-07-08.s.s1.explain: Misali, idan Aji 1 ya samu 14 da 11, Aji 2 kuma 9 da 11, idan an haɗa gidan namun daji yana da 23, gidan kayan tarihi kuma 22, saboda haka gidan namun daji yana da ƙuri'a 1 fiye. Idan Aji 1 ya samu 5 da 2, Aji 2 kuma 3 da 5, gidan namun daji yana da 8, gidan kayan tarihi kuma 7; bambanci har yanzu ƙuri'a 1 ne. Ko adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji ya bambanta, idan abin da ka sani kawai shi ne ‘nawa ne suka fi’, bambancin jimilla ƙuri'a 1 ne, wato bambancin ƙuri'u 3 da 2.
z-m-07-08.s.s2.prompt: Yi misalai biyu masu adadin masu zaɓe dabam-dabam inda Aji 1 ya fi gidan kayan tarihi da ƙuri'u 3, Aji 2 kuma gidan kayan tarihi ya fi da ƙuri'u 2. Aji 1 yana da z1 ƙuri'u na gidan namun daji da b1 na gidan kayan tarihi; Aji 2 kuma z2 na gidan namun daji da b2 na gidan kayan tarihi. Kowane aji yana da masu zaɓe 30 ko ƙasa da haka.

Ko da adadin ƙuri'u ya bambanta, bambancin jimillar iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-07-08.s.s3.prompt: Wani aboki ya ce, 'Ba mu san adadin ƙuri'un kowane aji ba, saboda haka ba za mu iya sanin sakamakon haɗawa ba.' Me za ka so ka amsa? Ta amfani da misalin (lambobin) da ka yi yanzu, rubuta dabam abin da za mu iya sani da abin da ba za mu iya sani ba tukuna.

z-m-07-04.thinking.1: Gyara hukunci da ƙarfin gwiwa ta sabon bayani
z-m-07-04.title: Mene ne launin ƙwallon ado na 25 a cikin sarƙar?
z-m-07-04.topic: Daidaita matsayi (lamba) da launi a tsarin maimaituwa
z-m-07-04.goal: Sanin zato da ake yi yayin hasashen darajar nesa daga ƙa’ida da aka gani a wani ɓangare, bayyana yadda hukunci da ƙarfin gwiwa ke sauyawa da sabon bayani, sannan a gano lambobin da launi ɗaya ke bayyana.
z-m-07-04.material: Yoona tana yin sarƙa, tana ƙirga ƙwallayen daga gaba: na 1, na 2, na 3, ... Launukan ƙwallayen ja, shuɗi, da rawaya ne, kuma da alama akwai ƙa’ida ga launukan da take jerawa. Zan faɗa launukan da kalmomi kawai.
z-m-07-04.thinking.0: Hasashen ƙa’ida daga wani ɓangare na bayanai da gwada ta
z-m-07-04.thinking.3: Ƙirƙiri lambobi da suka dace da ƙa’idar da kanka
z-m-07-04.prereq.0: Ƙirga abubuwan da ke jere ta lissafa matsayinsu na 1, 2, ...
z-m-07-04.prereq.1: Karanta tsare-tsaren da launi ko siffa ke maimaituwa (aji na 3)
z-m-07-04.s.s1.prompt: Mu yi hasashe yayin da muke koyon launukan ƙwallayen ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki zaɓi abin da ya fi maka dacewa.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ƙwallayen da aka sani zuwa yanzu a jere, ka haɗa lamba da launi.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo lambar farko da tsarin launi ɗaya zai sake farawa.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Launukan ƙwallaye na 1 zuwa 6 a jere su ne ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya, ja, shuɗi.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane launi kake tunanin ƙwallo ta 7 za ta kasance?
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya ne ke maimaituwa, na 7 shuɗi ce. Amma ƙwallaye 6 kawai muka gani, wata ƙa’ida dabam ma na iya kasancewa. Saboda haka ‘da alama shuɗi ce’ da ‘da wuri a yanke hukunci’ duk maganganu ne masu ma’ana a wannan mataki.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan zato ne cewa ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya suna maimaituwa. Mun wuce zagaye guda kaɗan ne kawai, saboda haka ƙarfin tabbaci bai kai ba.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi tunanin rawaya ta fito a na 4, don haka za ta sake fitowa a na 7? Duba tazarar tsakanin inda rawaya ta fito da lamba ta 7.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kana tunanin ja za ta ci gaba domin ta fito a na 5. Duba wane launi ne na 6, wato wanda ya biyo bayan na 5 kai tsaye.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za mu iya tantancewa daga ƙwallaye 6 kaɗai ba tukuna
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kasancewa mai taka-tsantsan domin an ga ƙwallaye kaɗan hali ne mai kyau. Duk da haka, duba ko akwai wata alama a cikin waɗanda aka gani.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Daga baya, launukan ƙwallaye na 7 zuwa 12 a jere su ne shuɗi, rawaya, ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya. Yanzu an tabbatar da duk ƙwallaye na 1 zuwa 12.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan muka ɗauka ƙa’idar tana ci gaba, wane launi kake tsammanin ƙwallo ta 25 za ta kasance?
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Har zuwa na 12, jerin guda 4 ya maimaitu sau uku. Na 24 ita ce ta ƙarshe a zagaye na shida (rawaya), na 25 kuma ita ce ta farko a sabon zagaye, ja. Amma ci gaba da ƙa’idar zato ne, don haka ‘ba za mu iya tantancewa ba’ ma taka-tsantsan ce mai ma’ana.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Jera lambobin da rawaya ta fito: 4, 8, 12, sannan ka ci gaba da rubutawa ka duba ko 25 na ciki.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mun ga har 12 kawai, saboda haka ba za mu iya tantancewa ba tukuna
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Taka-tsantsan abu ne mai kyau, amma idan ka ƙirga yawan maimaituwar tsarin a cikin 12, za ka sami ƙarin alamu.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ci gaba da rubuta lambobin da shuɗi ta fito: 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, sannan ka duba ko 25 na ciki.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauka cewa jerin yana maimaituwa kowane 4, sannan ya nuna inda 25 yake a sabon zagaye.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ga sabon bayani. Bayan an gama sarƙar, an duba ƙwallo ta 30, rawaya ce. (Har yanzu ba mu san launukan 13 zuwa 29 ba.)
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me ya faru da tunaninka game da ƙwallo ta 25 yanzu?
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Da ƙa’idar ta ci gaba, ta 30 (matsayi na 2 bayan zagaye 7 na ƙwallaye 4) shuɗi ce. Amma rawaya ce, don haka wataƙila ƙa’idar ta canza tsakanin 13 da 30. Idan sauyin ya faru bayan 25, ta 25 tana nan ja; idan kafin, launinta na iya canzawa. Saboda haka “ja ce amma tabbaci ya ragu” da “ba za mu iya tantancewa ba” sun dace, yayin da “tabbatacciya” ko “rawaya” ba su da tushe. (30th bead)
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ta 30 rawaya ce, saboda haka ta 25 ma rawaya ce
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ta 30 da ta 25 lambobi daban-daban ne. Ka yi tunanin ko rawayar ta 30 tana ƙayyade launin ta 25 kai tsaye.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ko da me ya faru da ta 30, ta 25 ja ce tabbatacciya
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Da farko duba ko ta 30 tana da launin da ƙa’idar ta bayar. Gano launin da ta 30 za ta kasance idan ƙa’idar ta ci gaba.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Har yanzu ina ganin ja ce amma ban da tabbaci kamar da ba
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne cewa ko da sabon bayani na iya girgiza ƙa’idar, idan wurin sauyin yana bayan ta 25, launin ta 25 na iya zama yadda yake.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Wataƙila ƙa’idar ta canza a tsakiya, don haka ba za a iya tantance ta 25 ba
z-m-07-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Da ba mu san inda ƙa’idar ta canza ba, wannan hukunci ne na taka-tsantsan. Ya danganta da ko wurin sauyin yana kafin ko bayan ta 25.
z-m-07-04.s.s1.reflect: Idan ka yanke shawarar ta 25 ja ce, shin labarin ta 30 ya sauya hukuncin kansa ne ko ya rage ƙarfin tabbaci kawai? Bayyana dalilin da ya sa amincewar ƙa’idar da aka gani a wani ɓangare ta danganta da nisan da aka gwada.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.prompt: Seoyun ta ɗauka ƙa’idar za ta ci gaba har zuwa ta 25, sannan ta gano launin ta 25 kamar haka. Zaɓi layin da yake da kuskure.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.0: Gwada hanyar Seoyun a kan ta 6 ko ta 7 wadda ka san launinta, sannan ka kwatanta da ainihin launi.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jera launukan ƙwallaye masu lambobi 1, 5, 9, 13 kusa da juna, ka duba abin da hanyar Seoyun ta rasa.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.line.0: Ƙwallayen suna maimaita ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya. Zagaye guda yana da ƙwallaye 4.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.line.1: Idan aka raba 25 da 4, rabon 6 ne ragowar 1.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.line.2: Rabon 6 ne, saboda haka launin ƙwallo ta 25 iri ɗaya ne da ta 6.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.line.3: Ta 6 shuɗi ce, saboda haka ta 25 ma shuɗi ce.
z-m-07-04.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. Rabon yana nuna zagayen da ake ciki kawai, ragowar kuma tana nuna matsayi a cikin zagayen. Idan ragowar 1 ce, launin iri ɗaya ne da ƙwallo ta 1 a zagayen (ja). Idan aka yi amfani da wannan hanyar a kan ta 6 da aka san launinta, rabon 6÷4 shi ne 1, saboda haka daidai da ta 1 (ja) ce, amma ainihin ta 6 shuɗi ce. Shuɗin layi na 4 sakamakon kuskuren layi na 3 ne. Idan aka gano daidai, ta 25 ja ce.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.prompt: Idan muka ɗauka ƙa’idar ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, rawaya tana ci gaba, gano lambobi uku daban-daban na ƙwallayen rawaya ka rubuta. (Lambobi daga 1 zuwa 40)
z-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta launukan ƙwallaye na 1 zuwa 12 tare da lambobinsu, sannan ka yi alama ga duk lambobin da suke rawaya.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.1: Duba tazarar lambobin da aka yi wa alama, sannan ka ci gaba da wannan tazara har zuwa 40.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Sanya lambar ta zama lamba ta halitta tsakanin 1 da 40.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Lamba ce inda rawaya ke fitowa.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Ƙwallon lambar nan ba rawaya ba ce. Daga lambar farko da rawaya ta fito, ƙirga tazarar da rawaya ke fitowa.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.explain: Rawaya ita ce ƙwallo ta ƙarshe a zagaye mai ƙwallaye 4, saboda haka tana fitowa a lambobin da ake ƙirgawa da 4 kamar 4, 8, 12, ... Cikin 1 zuwa 40 akwai guda goma: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Rubuta abin da lambobin da ka gano suka yi tarayya da shi, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa rawaya ke fitowa a waɗannan lambobin.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Jera lambobin da ka gano daga ƙarami sannan ka rubuta bambance-bambancen da ke tsakaninsu.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Tuna matsayin rawaya a cikin zagaye.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka kwatanta lambobin da ka rubuta da tebur don tabbatar da dukkansu rawaya ne?
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana abin da suka yi tarayya da shi a matsayin tazara ko hanyar rabawa?
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Shin ka haɗa a bayanin matsayin rawaya a cikin zagaye?
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.0: 4, 8, da 28 duk ninkin 4 ne. Zagaye guda ƙwallaye 4 ne, rawaya kuma ita ce ta ƙarshe, saboda haka tana fitowa kowane ƙwallaye 4.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Idan aka raba lambar da 4, ragowar 0 ce. Rawaya ita ce ƙwallo ta huɗu a zagaye, saboda haka lambobin da ragowarsu 0 ce kaɗai za su zama rawaya.
z-m-07-04.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da ta bayyana su a matsayin ‘lambobin da suka rabu babu ragowa’.

z-m-07-02.title: Za mu iya gano lambar da ta fi girma ta hanyar kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kawai?
z-m-07-02.topic: Kwatanta girman lambobi masu wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma (lambar kafin da bayan maki goma).
z-m-07-02.goal: Ka san cewa dole ne a fara kwatanta lambobi na gaba da maki goma, sannan ka bambanta yanayin da hanyar kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kaɗai take aiki da wanda ba ta aiki.
z-m-07-02.material: Mun auna tsawon zaren ribbon uku, suka zama 0.9 m, 1.2 m, da 0.4 m. Hyeonu ya so ya jera su daga mafi gajarta, ya yi tunani kamar haka. (Ana karanta 0.9 a matsayin 'sifili digo tara', 1.2 kuma 'ɗaya digo biyu'.)
z-m-07-02.thinking.0: Nemo layin magani da ya yi tsalle ba tare da hujja ba.
z-m-07-02.thinking.1: Yi lambobi da dama cikin zangon da aka bayar.
z-m-07-02.thinking.2: Tsara sharuddan da hanya take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu.
z-m-07-02.prereq.0: Ma'ana, karantawa da rubuta lambobi masu wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma (0.1, 1/10), da karanta layin lambobi (matakin aji na 3).
z-m-07-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi a tunanin Hyeonu da ke da kuskure.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko gano ko 0.9 m da 1.2 m wacce ta fi 1 m tsawo.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya 0, 1, 2 a layin lambobi, ka sanya 0.4, 0.9, 1.2 a wurarensu.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.line.0: Tsawon zaren ribbon ɗin su ne 0.9 m, 1.2 m, da 0.4 m.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.line.1: Muna kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kawai. Su ne 9, 2, da 4.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.line.2: Idan an jera daga ƙarami, 2, 4, 9, to jerin zai zama 1.2 m, 0.4 m, 0.9 m.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka 1.2 m ce mafi gajarta, 0.9 m kuma mafi tsawo.
z-m-07-02.s.s1.explain: Tushen kuskuren yana layi na 2, inda aka kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kawai. Ga ƙimomin decimal, dole ne a fara kwatanta lambar kafin maki (1 da 0). 1.2 ya fi 1 girma, 0.9 kuma ya gaza 1, don haka 1.2 ta fi girma. Layi na 3 ya bi hanyar layi na 2 ya ba da jerin da ba daidai ba (1.2 m, 0.4 m, 0.9 m); a layi na 4 kuma kuskuren ya fito a matsayin ƙarshe '1.2 m ce mafi gajarta.' Jerin daidai shi ne 0.4 m, 0.9 m, 1.2 m.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta lambobi mabambanta guda 3 masu wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma (raka'ar 0.1) da suka fi 0.9 amma suka gaza 1.5.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ci gaba da lambobin ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kana ƙara 0.1 daga 0.9.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tsaya kafin ka kai 1.5, ka tabbatar duk lambobin da ka rubuta suna raka'ar 0.1.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.var.x: Lamba mai wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ta fi 0.9 girma, ta gaza 1.5. Duba lambobin da ke tsakaninsu a layin lambobi.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Lamba ce mai wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma (raka'ar 0.1).
z-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Rubuta ta a raka'ar 0.1 (lamba mai wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma). Misali: 0.4, 1.2.
z-m-07-02.s.s2.explain: Lambobi masu wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma tsakanin 0.9 da 1.5 su ne 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, da 1.4, guda biyar. Ƙara 0.1 ga 0.9 ya ba da 1.0; kuma dole a tsaya kafin 1.5.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.prompt: Yaushe hanyar Hyeonu ta 'kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kaɗai' ke aiki?
z-m-07-02.s.s3.hint.0: Yi ma'aurata da dama kamar 0.4 da 0.9, 1.2 da 1.7, 0.9 da 1.2; kwatanta sakamakon kwatanta lambobin bayan maki goma kaɗai da ainihin girman, sannan rubuta ma'auratan da suka yi daidai da waɗanda ba su yi ba.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta yadda lambobin kafin maki goma suke a ma'auratan da suka yi daidai da waɗanda ba su yi ba.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.o.a: Daidai ne kawai idan lambar kafin maki goma 0 ce.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.r.a: Gaskiya ne cewa hanyar tana daidai idan lambar kafin maki 0 ce, kamar 0.4 da 0.9. Amma duba ko tana daidai idan lambobin kafin maki duka 1 ne, kamar 1.2 da 1.7.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.o.b: Daidai ne idan lambobin kafin maki goma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.r.b: Idan lambobin kafin maki iri ɗaya ne, sai a kwatanta ragowar ɓangaren. Idan sun bambanta, dole ne a fara kwatanta lambobin kafin maki.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.o.c: Koyaushe daidai ne idan akwai lamba guda ɗaya bayan maki goma.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.r.c: 1.2 da 0.9 ma suna da lamba guda bayan maki goma, duk da haka hanyar ba daidai ba ce. Adadin lambobin bayan maki kaɗai ba ya raba yanayin.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.o.d: Tana aiki idan lambobin bayan maki goma sun bambanta.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.r.d: 1.2 da 0.9 suna da lambobi mabambanta bayan maki goma, amma hanyar ba daidai ba ce. Bambancin lambobin kaɗai bai isa ba.
z-m-07-02.s.s3.explain: Idan lambobin da ke gaban waƙafi daidai suke, ya isa a kwatanta na bayan waƙafi kawai. Misali, tsakanin 1.2 da 1.7, kwatanta 2 da 7 ya nuna 1.7 ya fi. Idan lambobin gaba sun bambanta, dole a fara kwatanta su.

z-m-07-05.title: Idan muka sauya lambobin layin sama, tsarin teburin ƙari ma yana canzawa?
z-m-07-05.topic: Tsarin yadda lambobi ke canzawa yayin matsawa a kwance, a tsaye, ko a diagonal cikin teburin ƙari
z-m-07-05.goal: Sanin cewa canjin lamba tsakanin akwatunan teburin ƙari yana ƙayyadewa da canjin lambobin taken layuka da ginshiƙai, sannan a yi amfani da wannan don tsara teburin da ke da tsarin da ake so da kanka.
z-m-07-05.material:
Mun ƙirƙiri teburin ƙari. Lambobin ginshiƙin hagu su ne 1, 2, 3, 4; na layin sama kuma 2, 4, 6, 8. A akwatin da layi da ginshiƙi suka haɗu, rubuta jimillar lambobin biyu.

  + |  2   4   6   8
----+----------------
  1 |  3   5   7   9
  2 |  4   6   8  10
  3 |  5   7   9  11
  4 |  6   8  10  12

(Idan aka karanta: layi na farko 3, 5, 7, 9 / na biyu 4, 6, 8, 10 / na uku 5, 7, 9, 11 / na huɗu 6, 8, 10, 12.) A teburin ƙari na littafin, layin sama 1, 2, 3, 4 ne, saboda haka matsawa akwatin ɗaya dama yana ƙara lamba 1.
z-m-07-05.thinking.1: Nemo dalili mara daidai kan motsi ta hanyoyi daban-daban
z-m-07-05.thinking.2: Tsara tebur da ya cika sharuddan da kanka
z-m-07-05.prereq.0: Yadda ake karanta teburin ƙari: rubuta jimillar lambobi biyu a akwatin da layi da ginshiƙi suka haɗu (aji na 3)
z-m-07-05.prereq.1: Duba bambancin lambobin akwatuna maƙwabta a tebur.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.prompt: A wannan tebur, idan ka bar ginshiƙin hagu yadda yake, ka sauya layin sama kawai zuwa 3, 6, 9, 12, me zai faru da lamba yayin matsawa akwatin ɗaya dama a layi ɗaya?
z-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.0: A teburin da aka sauya layinsa na sama zuwa 3, 6, 9, 12, rubuta jimillar kai tsaye a layin da ginshiƙin hagu yake 1.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko bambancin lambobin maƙwabta iri ɗaya ne a sauran layuka ma (inda ginshiƙin hagu yake 2 ko 3).
z-m-07-05.s.s1.r.a: A teburin littafi (layin sama 1, 2, 3, 4) daidai ne. Amma duba bambancin lambobi biyu maƙwabta a layin sama.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne na lura cewa canjin layin sama daga 3 zuwa 6 da 6 zuwa 9 yana bayyana iri ɗaya a jimilloli.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ƙaruwa da 2 ita ce canjin teburin asali (layin sama 2, 4, 6, 8). Sake duba bambancin lambobin maƙwabta a sabon layin sama.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.o.d: Bambancin akwatin kowane wuri daban ne, don haka ba za mu iya tantancewa ba.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka gano bambancin tsakanin akwatuna biyu maƙwabta a layi guda a wurare da dama, za ka san ko bambancin ɗaya ne ko ya bambanta.
z-m-07-05.s.s1.explain: A layi guda, lambar ginshiƙin hagu ba ta canzawa, layin sama kaɗai ke ƙaruwa da 3, kamar 3, 6, 9, 12. Saboda haka matsawa akwatin ɗaya dama yana ƙara jimilla da 3. (Idan layin sama na teburin farko 2, 4, 6, 8 ne, yana ƙaruwa da 2.)
z-m-07-05.s.s2.prompt: Haeun ta bayyana yadda lambobi ke canzawa yayin motsi tsakanin akwatunan teburin sama kamar haka. Zaɓi layin da yake da kuskure.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo akwatin da ke da 7 a tebur, ka karanta lambar akwatin da ke ƙasa hagu da mataki ɗaya.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.1: Matsawa ƙasa hagu daga sauran akwatuna ma, rubuta yawan canjin lamba a kowane lokaci.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.line.0: Matsawa akwatin ɗaya dama yana ƙara lambar layin sama da 2, saboda haka jimillar ta ƙaru da 2.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.line.1: Matsawa akwatin ɗaya ƙasa yana ƙara lambar ginshiƙin hagu da 1, saboda haka jimillar ta ƙaru da 1.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.line.2: Saboda haka matsawa akwatin ɗaya ƙasa dama yana ƙara jimillar da 3.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.line.3: Sai matsawa akwatin ɗaya ƙasa hagu yana rage jimillar da 3.
z-m-07-05.s.s2.explain: Layi na 4 ne ba daidai ba. Matsawa ƙasa hagu yana tafiya akwatin ɗaya hagu, ya rage 2, kuma ƙasa akwatin ɗaya, ya ƙara 1. Ragewa 2 da ƙari 1 yana nufin raguwar 1 gaba ɗaya. Misali, matsawa ƙasa hagu daga 7 da ke akwatin na uku a layin farko yana kaiwa 6 da ke akwatin na biyu a layi na biyu, wato ya ragu da 1. Layuka na 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.prompt: Mu ƙirƙiri namu teburin ƙari. Bar ginshiƙin hagu 1, 2, 3, 4 kamar yadda yake, sannan zaɓi sabbin lambobi a, b, c don akwatuna uku na farko a layin sama ta yadda jimillar za ta ƙaru da 5 kowane motsin akwatin ɗaya dama. Ƙirƙiri tebura biyu daban-daban. (Layin sama a, b, c ne daga hagu, dukansu lambobi ne na halitta tsakanin 1 da 30.)
z-m-07-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ka ba da misalin yadda za a zaɓi layin sama domin bambancin lambobin makwabta a layin ya zama 5.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ta amfani da a, b, c ɗin da ka zaɓa, rubuta jimillar layi na farko (idan ginshiƙin hagu 1 ne), sannan ka duba ko tana ƙaruwa da 5.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.var.a: Lamba ta farko a layin sama
z-m-07-05.s.s3.var.b: Lamba ta biyu a layin sama
z-m-07-05.s.s3.var.c: Lamba ta uku a layin sama
z-m-07-05.s.s3.ok.c1: Lambobin lambar halitta ne daga 1 zuwa 30.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Sanya a, b, c su zama lambobin halitta daga 1 zuwa 30.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.ok.c2: Yana ƙaruwa da 5 daga akwati na farko zuwa na biyu.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Ba ya ƙaruwa da 5 daga a zuwa b. Gano bambancin a da b.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.ok.c3: Yana ƙaruwa da 5 daga akwati na biyu zuwa na uku.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Ba ya ƙaruwa da 5 daga b zuwa c. Gano bambancin b da c.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.explain: Idan layin sama ya kasance 1, 6, 11, jimillar tana ƙaruwa da 5 a kowane mataki zuwa dama a jeren. Idan ka canja lambar farawa, 3, 8, 13 ko 10, 15, 20 ma za su yiwu. Abin da ya fi muhimmanci shi ne bambancin lambobin makwabta a layin sama ya zama 5.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.prompt: Bayyana yadda ka zaɓi layin sama da dalilin da ya sa jimillar ke ƙaruwa da 5 yayin matsawa zuwa dama.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Rubuta jimillar lambar 1 ta ginshiƙin hagu tare da lambobin farko da na biyu na layin sama, sannan ka gano bambancinsu.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.hint.1: Idan jimillar ta canza, nuna wanne daga cikin lambobin biyu ne ya canza.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka rubuta jimillar layi na farko da lambobin da ka zaɓa, sannan ka duba ko da gaske suna ƙaruwa da 5?
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayar da dalilin cewa lambar ginshiƙin hagu ba ta canzawa, lambobin layin sama kaɗai ne ke canzawa?
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya faɗin yadda teburorin biyun da ka yi suka yi kama da juna kuma suka bambanta?
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.model.0: Na sa layin sama ya ƙaru da 5, kamar 1, 6, 11. A jere ɗaya, lambar ginshiƙin hagu ba ta canzawa, lambobin layin sama kaɗai ne ke ƙaruwa da 5; saboda haka jimillar ma tana ƙaruwa da 5.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.model.1: Na zaɓi 3, 8, 13. Idan ɗaya daga cikin lambobin da aka haɗa (na ginshiƙin hagu) ya tsaya yadda yake, ɗayan kuma (na sama) ya ƙaru da 5, jimillar ma tana ƙaruwa da 5.
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da ta bayyana dalili ɗaya ta amfani da kalmomin ‘lambobin da aka haɗa.’
z-m-07-05.s.s3.because.model.2: Na yi amfani da 1, 6, 11. Lambar hagu ba ta canza ba, ta sama kaɗai ce ke ƙaruwa da 5, don haka jimillar ma tana ƙaruwa da 5.

z-m-07-06.title: Idan ka haɗa alwatika masu kusurwar dama guda biyu iri ɗaya, shin a koyaushe za ka samu murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu?
z-m-07-06.topic: Siffofin da ake samu ta haɗa alwatika masu kusurwar dama iri ɗaya guda biyu (siffa da kewayen siffa)
z-m-07-06.goal: Gwada maganar ‘a koyaushe’ ta canja gefuna da hanyoyin haɗawa domin nemo misalin da ya karya ta, sannan ka bayyana yadda kewayen siffar ke canzawa idan gefen da aka haɗa ya ɓuya.
z-m-07-06.material:
Akwai takardu biyu masu launi masu siffar alwatika mai kusurwar dama. Girmansu da siffofinsu iri ɗaya ne. Gefuna biyu da ke kusa da kusurwar dama tsawonsu 3 cm da 4 cm ne, mafi tsawo kuma 5 cm ne. Haɗa su daidai ta gefuna masu tsawo iri ɗaya ba tare da gibi ko rufewa ba domin samun sabuwar siffa. Za ka iya juya ko jujjuya takardar kafin haɗawa.
Seoa ta ce, ‘Idan ka haɗa alwatika masu kusurwar dama iri ɗaya guda biyu, a koyaushe murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu za ka samu!’
Ana karanta 3 cm da ‘santimita uku.’
z-m-07-06.thinking.0: Bambance lokacin da maganar ta yi daidai da lokacin da ba ta yi ba
z-m-07-06.thinking.1: Nemo misalan da ke karya ta ta canja gefen da aka haɗa
z-m-07-06.thinking.2: Faɗi yadda gefen da aka haɗa yake shafar kewayen siffa
z-m-07-06.prereq.0: San ma'anar alwatika mai kusurwar dama da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu (matakin aji na 3)
z-m-07-06.prereq.1: Kewayen siffa shi ne tsawon da ke kewaye da gefenta sau ɗaya
z-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da abin da Seoa ta ce?
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yi alwatika biyu masu kusurwar dama (3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm) daga takarda, sannan ka zana siffofin da ka samu yayin sauya gefen da aka haɗa. Idan ba ka da takarda, ka yi tunanin kusurwar dama kamar kusurwar littafi, ka yi a zuciyarka.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: A siffar da aka haɗa, duba ko kusurwoyi huɗu duka kusurwoyin dama ne kuma tana da gefuna huɗu.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Ya danganta da yadda aka haɗa su
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da za ka gwada ta hanyar sauya gefen da aka haɗa da alkiblar sanya shi. Zai fi bayyana idan ka gano waɗanne yanayi ke samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Ba za ka iya sani kafin haɗawa ba
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka san kusurwoyin dama da tsawon gefuna, saboda haka za ka iya warwarewa a zuciya tun kafin haɗa takardun. Ka tuna ko duk kusurwoyin murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu kusurwoyin dama ne.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ko ta yaya aka haɗa su, ba za su taɓa zama murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu ba
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Shin ka tabbatar da gaske babu hanyar haɗawa da za ta samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu? Ka sake duba yanayin haɗa gefuna mafi tsawo.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Ko ta yaya aka haɗa su, za su zama murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bi maganar Seoa kai tsaye. Ka kuma gwada da kanka yanayin haɗa gefuna 3 cm.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: Idan ka haɗa gefuna 5 cm, ka juya ɗaya daga cikin sassan, zai zama murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu mai faɗin 3 cm da tsayin 4 cm. Idan ka haɗa gefuna 3 cm, jujjuya ɗaya yana samar da babban alwatika, juya ɗaya kuma yana samar da siffa mai gefe huɗu karkatacciya, don haka ba murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu ba ne. Saboda haka ya danganta da gefen haɗawa da yadda aka yi.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Bari mu nemo kewayen siffar da aka haɗa. Jimillar tsawon dukkan gefuna uku na alwatika mai kusurwar dama ɗaya 12 cm ce. Idan an haɗa gefuna masu tsawo ɗaya, bari tsawon gefen haɗin ya zama j cm (ɗaya daga 3, 4, 5), sannan ka nemo yanayi biyu dabam-dabam da kewayen siffar ta fi 14 cm.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo jimillar kewayen sassan biyu.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi amfani da takarda ka duba ko gefen da aka haɗa ya kasance a kan kewayen siffar, sannan ka cire tsawon ɓangaren da ba ya nan.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Gefen da za a iya haɗawa ne.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole gefen da aka haɗa ya zama ɗaya daga cikin 3, 4, 5 cm. Sassan biyun iri ɗaya ne, don haka ana haɗa gefuna masu tsawo ɗaya.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kewayen siffa bai fi 14 cm ba. Duba ko wani gefe yana ɓoyuwa yayin haɗawa.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Kewayen sashi ɗaya 3+4+5=12 cm ne, saboda haka sassa biyu suna da 24 cm. Gefen da aka haɗa yana shiga ciki ya ɓuya a sassan biyu. Haɗa gefen 3 cm yana ba da 24−6=18 cm, gefen 4 cm yana ba da 24−8=16 cm, gefen 5 cm kuma 24−10=14 cm. Haɗa gefen 3 cm ko 4 cm ne ke samar da kewayen da ya fi 14 cm.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Me za ka so ka gaya wa Seoa? Ka ba da hanyar haɗawa guda ɗaya da ke samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu da wadda ba ta samarwa, sannan ka rubuta gefen da ka haɗa da yadda ka yi.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ka tuna yanayin haɗa gefuna 3 cm, 4 cm, da 5 cm da ka yi amfani da su wajen gano kewayen, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirga kusurwoyin dama nawa ne siffar take da su bayan haɗawa.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka tabbatar ta duba kusurwoyi huɗun cewa siffar da haɗawar da ka bayyana ta samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu ne (ko ba haka ba)?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka rubuta a sarari wane gefe aka haɗa, ta tsawonsa?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka rubuta kana sane cewa misalin da ya karya maganar guda ɗaya ya isa ya ƙaryata ‘a koyaushe’?
z-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Ba haka yake a koyaushe ba. Idan ka haɗa gefuna 5 cm ka juya ɗaya daga cikin sassan, za ka samu murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu mai faɗin 3 cm da tsayin 4 cm; amma haɗa gefuna 3 cm ba ya samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.model.1: Ya danganta da gefen da aka haɗa. Idan ka haɗa gefuna mafi tsawo za ka iya samar da murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu, amma idan ka haɗa gajerun gefuna 4 cm ba zai zama ba.
z-m-07-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Rubuta ‘gefe gajere’ kaɗai ya isa, amma rubuta tsawon gefen yana ƙara bayyana.

z-m-07-10.title: Me za mu iya faɗi game da jakunkuna biyu daga sakamakon da Seoha da Haram suka samu?
z-m-07-10.topic: Sakamako na iya bambanta ko da sharudda iri ɗaya ne (yiwuwar faruwa).
z-m-07-10.goal: Ka san cewa ba za a iya yanke shawarar cewa jakunkuna biyu sun bambanta daga ƴan sakamakon jarrabawar sau 10 ba; ka faɗi iyakar yadda sakamakon yake zama alama da yadda za a ƙara bincike.
z-m-07-10.material:
Akwai jakunkuna biyu da aka gauraya marmara ja da shuɗi a ciki (Jaka 가, Jaka 나). Ba mu san adadin marmara a kowace jaka ko jakunkunan iri ɗaya ne ko bambanta ba. Seoha ta ɗauki marmara ɗaya daga Jaka 가, Haram kuma daga Jaka 나, suka duba launi suka mayar da ita; kowannensu ya yi haka sau 10.
Jaka 가 (Seoha): ja sau 7, shuɗi sau 3
Jaka 나 (Haram): ja sau 4, shuɗi sau 6
Seoha ta ce, 'Jakata tana da ja fiye, ta Haram kuma tana da shuɗi fiye. Jakunkunan sun bambanta!'
z-m-07-10.thinking.0: Bincika ko sakamakon kaɗai ya ba da damar yanke hukunci.
z-m-07-10.thinking.2: Tsara ka rubuta hukuncinka da shaidarsa.
z-m-07-10.prereq.0: Ƙirga abin da zai iya faruwa bisa adadin lokutan, ka tsara a tebur.
z-m-07-10.prereq.1: Ma'anar yau da kullum ta 'mai yiwuwa/ba mai yiwuwa ba' da 'tabbas' (matakin aji na 3).
z-m-07-10.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da maganar Seoha? Zaɓi abin da ya fi dacewa bisa wannan sakamakon kaɗai.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta sakamakon Seoha da na Haram gefe da gefe a tebur.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.hint.1: A ɗauka sun ɗauko daga jaka ɗaya; ka yi tunanin ko irin waɗannan sakamako za su iya faruwa.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.a: Ba za mu iya cewa komai ba daga sakamakon da aka zana.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.a: Sakamakon ma alama ce. Za ka iya cewa jakar da aka samu ja da yawa wataƙila tana da ɗan ƙarin ja. Tsalle zuwa hukunci da kuma yin watsi da alama abubuwa ne dabam.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.b: Jaka 가 tana da ja fiye, Jaka 나 kuma shuɗi fiye.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya karɓi maganar Seoha yadda take. Ka yi tunanin ko sakamakon zana sau 10 daga jaka ɗaya ma zai iya bambanta haka.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.c: Jaka 가 tana da marmara ja 7, Jaka 나 kuma ja 4.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.c: Adadin zane ba adadin marmara ba ne. An mayar da marmara kowane lokaci, saboda haka ana iya zana marmara ɗaya sau da dama.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.o.d: Daga zane sau 10 kawai ba za mu iya yanke cewa jakunkunan biyu sun bambanta ba.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana karɓar sakamakon a matsayin alama amma ya gane ana buƙatar ƙarin dubawa. Ka tuna cewa sakamako na iya bambanta ko daga jaka ɗaya ne.
z-m-07-10.s.s1.explain: Ko daga jaka ɗaya ne, idan aka zana sau 10 kowanne, ja na iya fitowa sau 7 ko 4. Don haka ko sakamakon ya bambanta, ba za a iya cewa jakunkunan sun bambanta ba. Amma wannan ba yana nufin sakamakon ba alama ba ne. Za a iya cewa gefen da ja ya fi fitowa yana da ɗan yiwuwar samun ja fiye.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.prompt: Wadanne hanyoyi za su taimaka wajen gano ko jakunkunan biyu iri ɗaya ne ko sun bambanta? Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da za su taimaka.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowace hanya, rubuta sabon bayanin da za ka samu bayan amfani da ita.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda amincewa da sakamakon farko ya bambanta da tattara sababbin sakamako.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.a: Ƙara yawan zane, a haɗa sakamakon.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.a: Yayin da yawan zane ke ƙaruwa, sakamakon yakan kusanto rabon marmara a jakar, saboda haka alamar tana zama abin dogaro.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.b: A amince da gefen da ja ya fi fitowa a sakamakon yanzu.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.b: Amincewa da sakamakon da ake da shi yadda yake ba ya ƙara sabon bayani, saboda haka ba ya ƙarfafa hukuncin farko.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.c: Kowannensu ya zana sau ɗaya kawai, ya yanke hukunci bisa launin wannan marmara.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.c: Idan aka yanke hukunci da zane guda ɗaya na ƙari, kusan ba za a iya cewa komai ba. Dole ne a tara sakamakon zane da yawa domin a samu alama.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.o.d: A fitar da duk marmara a ƙirga su bisa launi.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.r.d: Idan aka fitar da su aka ƙirga kai tsaye, za a fi tabbatar ko jakunkunan iri ɗaya ne. Amma idan wasa ne da ba a yarda a fitar ba, ba za a yi amfani da wannan ba.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.explain: Ƙara yawan zane da haɗa sakamakon yana sa alamar ta zama abin dogaro, fitar da marmara duka a ƙirga kuma yana tabbatar kai tsaye. Amincewa da sakamakon yanzu yadda yake ko zana sau ɗaya na ƙari kusan ba ya kawo sabon bayani.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.acc.0: Idan wasa ne da ba a iya fitar da marmara a ƙirga ba, hanya mafi kyau ita ce ƙara yawan zane a haɗa sakamakon.
z-m-07-10.s.s2.acc.1: Idan aka fitar da su aka ƙirga, za a sani tabbas. Zai kuma dace a yi tunanin hanyar ƙara yawan zane idan ba za a iya fitar da su ba.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.prompt: Me za ka so ka faɗa wa Seoha? Ka rubuta abin da za a yi don ƙara dubawa, kana girmama sakamakon Seoha.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fara da gaskiyar cewa Seoha da Haram kowannensu ya zana sau 10.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.hint.1: Raba sakamakon Seoha zuwa ɓangaren da za a iya amincewa da shi da wanda ba a tabbatar ba tukuna.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka daraja sakamakon Seoha (sau 7) ba tare da yanke hukunci ba?
z-m-07-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Akwai abin da ka kwatanta da sakamakon Haram?
z-m-07-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Hanyar dubawar da ka bayyana da gaske tana ƙara sabon bayani?
z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.0: Seoha, fitowar ja sau 7 daga 10 na iya nuna akwai ja fiye. Amma Haram ta samu 4, don haka ko daga jaka ɗaya ne ana iya samun bambanci haka. Mu ƙara yawan zane mu haɗa sakamakon.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.1: Ba za mu iya yanke cewa sun bambanta ba tukuna. Mun gwada zane sau 10 kowanne kawai, don haka idan muka ƙara zane mu kwatanta yawan fitowar ja, za mu fi sani.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan yanayi ne da ba a ambaci sakamakon Seoha kai tsaye ba, amma ba a yanke hukunci ba kuma an bayyana hanya.
z-m-07-10.s.s3.model.2: Ko daga jaka ɗaya ne, hakan na iya faruwa kwatsam. Mu ƙara zane kowannenmu, mu kwatanta jimillar sakamako (sau 7, sau 4).
